propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui beatorum Martyrum tuorum Gordiani et
Epimachi solemnia colimus, eorum apud te intercessionibus adjuvemur. Per
Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Complete own commemoration Collect, including actual Per Dominum./Through our Lord.; donor omits commas after Da and colimus. Words match throughout under stress/ligature presentation only. Own prayer expressly headed Prayer, Secret and Postcommunion of Sts. Gordian and Epimachus under May10. unitate.

intercedentibus sanctis Martyribus tuis Gordiano et Epimacho, per haec contra
omnia adversa muniamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
